snippet.title: Profaned - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Profaned now!!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3935170/Profaned/

Twitter/X:
https://x.com/RFGEmmanuel

Discord: 
https://discord.gg/wsa4mjkPeP

Story:
Profaned is an FPS that will take you through an Egyptian world overtaken by evil creatures.

Explore beautiful locations and dark underground areas where you will be trapped in dangerous encounters!

Use different powerful weapons to fight them, from classic weapons like the revolver and shotgun to more moderns equipment's like the Napalm Launcher and Tesla Gun. 

Face enemies ranging from Anubis to mummies and other monstrous creatures.

Early Access release is planned to include 6 maps plus 1 boss map, with 2 more episodes to follow.
